final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require one approving review before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: Please review before sending: the approved answer and the live setting disagree. Approved answer answer:c4805da2-c96d-4a8d-9bae-9e455cefa720 (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-17) says two approving reviews are required. A live check of harborlight/app at 2026-11-17T01:10:19Z found that branch main is protected but needs only 1 approving review (the rule does apply to administrators). I wrote the draft from the live setting because the approved 'two reviews' wording isn't true right now. The control owner should decide which to fix: raise the GitHub setting to 2 reviews, or update the approved answer to 1. After that, run the check again and finalise the wording. The check covers only harborlight/app, so the answer does not speak for other repositories.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:c4805da2-c96d-4a8d-9bae-9e455cefa: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:9c226054-1565-4c90-81eb-6961c1cdc: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:b78dbeca-bb29-4a78-97d5-0aefa0e0f: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:fd8511b9-685a-4682-b1ef-da40dff0a: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:285b5271-4921-4e1f-8321-91c6d0234: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
evidence:414dd5db-9335-4392-9ba4-8fba011: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 1 approving review before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-17 01:10 UTC.
